Old split module paths, Result/error formatting and fixture struct-field changes do not establish behavior by themselves. Persist raw bodies and every assertion; current checked constructors, exact typed fields, configured persistent scratch and all gates stand. No source is transplanted. Accepted artifact digest and proof claims are distinct authority: Current accepted_artifact_digest zeroes only self-digest fields and binds canonical envelope metadata/IR/evidence; source_digest retains workflow identity. Thus artifact.digest==workflow.digest or source_digest==artifact.digest is not the current invariant. VerificationProof::new does not mint proof flags/counts/durability: legacy claims remain0/false and actual typed evidence is recomputed. Reject literal2/15 gate authority/all-true flags, accepted_at_seq0-after-submit and unchecked workflow rehash fixtures without undoing accepted envelope binding or issued sequence. Exact trailing-byte refusal and diagnostic intent: Authored controls reject1/100/large extra bytes, distinguish short/exact payload, and assert UnexpectedTrailingBytes offsets/diagnostic code. Current envelope and typed payload decoders already fail closed with PostcardDecodeFailed(DeserializeBadEncoding) for suffixes. Preserve exact no-trailing acceptance and boundary/nonallocation intent; source-derived differing error surface requires current contract qualification, not adding a diagnostic variant or accepting extra bytes. Historical deadline/slot-extra representation not imported: Added deadline_ms30000 in Wait/Ask record fixtures and typed SlotWriteExtra in place of encoded envelope bytes are specific proposed persisted shape changes. Current stable record constructors, versioned encoded slot extra and distinct RetryTimerV1 own accepted deadlines/taint evidence. Keep actual timer/slot/taint behavior goals under the row qualifications; rejecting literal shape does not qualify cold recovery. Journal exact durability/index/duplicate and recovery-stamp custody: Actual diff changes roundtrip fields/record fixtures, exact batch/durability counts, accepted identical duplicate semantics, all-keyspace iteration, close result and index marker observations. Preserve current per-run sequences and atomic nonmutation; current duplicate policy must distinguish identical queued replay from durable conflicting append. Additional stamp persistence/reopen/no-alias controls imply old kind7/key family and are not restored; progress/lastseq persistence intent remains under actual accepted snapshot/journal owner.
